about.description: Jingsh Law Firm was established in 1994 and is one of China's leading full-service law firms.

full.p1: Jingsh Law Firm was established in 1994 and has grown into one of the leading full-service law firms in China. With over 30 years of steady operation and standardized development, the firm's influence has radiated globally.
full.p2: The firm operates nearly 100 offices across approximately 50 countries and regions, providing one-stop legal services for clients in China and internationally.
full.p3: Jingsh has a team of over 9,000 lawyers. Many professionals hold advanced law degrees and additional qualifications such as CPA, tax advisor, and patent agent credentials.
full.p4: Leveraging its global network and multidisciplinary expertise, Jingsh is committed to delivering efficient, practical, and high-quality legal solutions to clients worldwide.
full.p5: Choose Jingsh — your trusted global legal partner.
